svādurasyāni kamale gṛhyantāṃ phaladāni ca .. 26 ..
2.39.d:
नानाविधानि रम्याणि पक्वानि च फलानि तु ॥
स्वादुरस्यानि कमले गृह्यन्तां फलदानि च ॥ 26 ॥

2.39.s:
surabhistanasambhūtaṃ susvādu sumanoharam ..
martyāmṛtaṃ ca gavyaṃ vai gṛhyatāmacyutapriye .. 27 ..
2.39.d:
सुरभिस्तनसम्भूतं सुस्वादु सुमनोहरम् ॥
मर्त्यामृतं च गव्यं वै गृह्यतामच्युतप्रिये ॥ 27 ॥

2.39.s:
susvādurasasaṃyuktamikṣuvṛkṣarasodbhavam ..
agnipakvamapakvaṃ vā guḍaṃ vai devi gṛhyatām .. 28 ..
2.39.d:
सुस्वादुरससंयुक्तमिक्षुवृक्षरसोद्भवम् ॥
अग्निपक्वमपक्वं वा गुडं वै देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 28 ॥

2.39.s:
yavagodhūmasasyānāṃ cūrṇareṇusamudbhavam ..
supakvaguḍagavyāktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ devi gṛhyatām .. 29 ..
2.39.d:
यवगोधूमसस्यानां चूर्णरेणुसमुद्भवम् ॥
सुपक्वगुडगव्याक्तं मिष्टान्नं देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 29 ॥

2.39.s:
sasyacūrṇodbhavaṃ pakvaṃ svastikādisamanvitam ..
mayā niveditaṃ devi piṣṭakaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2.39.30 ..
2.39.d:
सस्यचूर्णोद्भवं पक्वं स्वस्तिकादिसमन्वितम् ॥
मया निवेदितं देवि पिष्टकं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 2.39.30 ॥

2.39.s:
pārthivaṃ vṛkṣabhedaṃ ca vividhairdravyakārakam ..
susvādu rasasaṃyuktamaikṣavaṃ pratigṛhyatām..31..
2.39.d:
पार्थिवं वृक्षभेदं च विविधैर्द्रव्यकारकम् ॥
सुस्वादु रससंयुक्तमैक्षवं प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥31॥

2.39.s:
śītavāyupradaṃ caiva dāhe ca sukhadaṃ param ..
kamale gṛhyatāṃ cedaṃ vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram..32..
2.39.d:
शीतवायुप्रदं चैव दाहे च सुखदं परम् ॥
कमले गृह्यतां चेदं व्यजनं श्वेतचामरम्॥32॥

2.39.s:
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ..
jihvājāḍyacchedakaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām .. 33 ..
2.39.d:
ताम्बूलं च वरं रम्यं कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् ॥
जिह्वाजाड्यच्छेदकरं ताम्बूलं देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 33 ॥

2.39.s:
suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam ..
jagajjīvanarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ devi gṛhyatām .. 34 ..
2.39.d:
सुवासितं शीतलं च पिपासानाशकारणम् ॥
जगज्जीवनरूपं च जीवनं देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 34 ॥

2.39.s:
dehasaundaryyabījaṃ ca sadā śobhāvivarddhanam ..
kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ devi gṛhyatām .. 35 ..
2.39.d:
देहसौन्दर्य्यबीजं च सदा शोभाविवर्द्धनम् ॥
कार्पासजं च कृमिजं वसनं देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 35 ॥

2.39.s:
ratnasvarṇavikāraṃ ca dehasaukhyavivarddhanam ..
śobhādhānaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. .. 36 ..
2.39.d:
रत्नस्वर्णविकारं च देहसौख्यविवर्द्धनम् ॥
शोभाधानं श्रीकरं च भूषणं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ ॥ 36 ॥

2.39.s:
nānākusumasandarbhaṃ bahuśobhāpradaṃ param ..
suralokapriyaṃ śuddhaṃ mālyaṃ devi pragṛhyatām .. 37 ..
2.39.d:
नानाकुसुमसन्दर्भं बहुशोभाप्रदं परम् ॥
सुरलोकप्रियं शुद्धं माल्यं देवि प्रगृह्यताम् ॥ 37 ॥

2.39.s:
śuddhidaṃ śuddhirūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ..
gandhavastūdbhavaṃ ramyaṃ gandhaṃ devi pragṛhyatām ..38..
2.39.d:
शुद्धिदं शुद्धिरूपं च सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गलम् ॥
गन्धवस्तूद्भवं रम्यं गन्धं देवि प्रगृह्यताम् ॥38॥

2.39.s:
puṇyatīrthodakaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śuddhidaṃ sadā..
gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇakānte tvaṃ ramyamācamanīyakam .. 39 ..
2.39.d:
पुण्यतीर्थोदकं चैव विशुद्धं शुद्धिदं सदा॥
गृहाण कृष्णकान्ते त्वं रम्यमाचमनीयकम् ॥ 39 ॥

2.39.s:
ratnasāraissaṃgrathitaṃ puṣpacandanasaṃyutam ..
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sutalpaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2.39.40 ..
2.39.d:
रत्नसारैस्संग्रथितं पुष्पचन्दनसंयुतम् ॥
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्यं सुतल्पं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 2.39.40 ॥

2.39.s:
yadyaddravyamapūrvaṃ ca pṛthivyāmasti durlabham ..
devabhūṣāḍhyabhogyaṃ ca taddravyaṃ devi gṛhyatām .. 41 ..
2.39.d:
यद्यद्द्रव्यमपूर्वं च पृथिव्यामस्ति दुर्लभम् ॥
देवभूषाढ्यभोग्यं च तद्द्रव्यं देवि गृह्यताम् ॥ 41 ॥

2.39.s:
dravyāṇyetāni dattvā vai mūlena devapuṃgava ..
mūlaṃ jajāpa bhaktyā ca daśalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ ..42..
2.39.d:
द्रव्याण्येतानि दत्त्वा वै मूलेन देवपुंगव ॥
मूलं जजाप भक्त्या च दशलक्षं विधानतः ॥42॥

2.39.s:
japena daśalakṣeṇa mantrasiddhirbabhūva ha ..
mantraśca brahmaṇā dattaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvadā .. 43 ..
2.39.d:
जपेन दशलक्षेण मन्त्रसिद्धिर्बभूव ह ॥
मन्त्रश्च ब्रह्मणा दत्तः कल्पवृक्षश्च सर्वदा ॥ 43 ॥
2.39.m:
By reciting it one million times, perfection in the mantra was attained.
And the mantra given by Brahmā is ever a wish-fulfilling tree. (43)

2.39.s:
lakṣmīrmāyā kāmavāṇī tataḥ kamalavāsinī ..
svāhānto vaidiko mantrarājo'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ .. 44 ..
2.39.d:
लक्ष्मीर्माया कामवाणी ततः कमलवासिनी ॥
स्वाहान्तो वैदिको मन्त्रराजोऽयं द्वादशाक्षरः ॥ 44 ॥
2.39.m:
The seed syllables of Lakṣmī, Māyā, Kāma, and Vāṇī, then ‘kamalavāsinyai’,
Ending in ‘svāhā’—this Vedic king of mantras consists of twelve syllables: (44)

2.39.s:
śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā ..
kubero'nena mantreṇa sarvaiśvaryamavāptavān ..
rājarājeśvaro dakṣaḥ sāvarṇirmanureva ca .. 49 ..
2.39.d:
श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं ऐं कमलवासिन्यै स्वाहा ॥
कुबेरोऽनेन मन्त्रेण सर्वैश्वर्यमवाप्तवान् ॥
राजराजेश्वरो दक्षः सावर्णिर्मनुरेव च ॥ 49 ॥

2.39.s:
maṃgalo'nena mantreṇa saptadvīpavatīpatiḥ..
priyavratottānapādau kedāro nṛpa eva ca..46..
2.39.d:
मंगलोऽनेन मन्त्रेण सप्तद्वीपवतीपतिः॥
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ केदारो नृप एव च॥46॥
2.39.m:
By means of this mantra, Maṅgala became lord of the earth of seven continents,
As did Priyavrata, Uttānapāda, and King Kedāra. (46)

2.39.s:
ete ca siddhā rājendrā mantreṇānena nārada..
siddhe mantre mahālakṣmīrdadau śakrāya darśanam .. 47 ..
2.39.d:
एते च सिद्धा राजेन्द्रा मन्त्रेणानेन नारद॥
सिद्धे मन्त्रे महालक्ष्मीर्ददौ शक्राय दर्शनम् ॥ 47 ॥
2.39.m:
These lordly kings attained perfection through this mantra, O Nārada.
When the mantra was perfected, Mahālakṣmī revealed herself to Śakra. (47)

2.39.s:
ratnendravyūhakhacitavimānasthā varapradā ..
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ chādayantī tviṣā ca sā .. 48 ..
2.39.d:
रत्नेन्द्रव्यूहखचितविमानस्था वरप्रदा ॥
सप्तद्वीपवतीं पृथ्वीं छादयन्ती त्विषा च सा ॥ 48 ॥
2.39.m:
Seated on a celestial chariot set with arrays of supreme jewels, granting boons,
Covering the earth of seven continents with her radiance, (48)

2.39.s:
śvetacampakavarṇābhā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakārikā .. 49 ..
2.39.d:
श्वेतचम्पकवर्णाभा रत्नभूषणभूषिता ॥
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्या भक्तानुग्रहकारिका ॥ 49 ॥
2.39.m:
Possessing a complexion resembling the white campaka flower, adorned with jewelled ornaments,
With a serene face slightly smiling, bestowing grace upon devotees, (49)

2.39.s:
bibhratī ratnamālāṃ ca koṭi candrasamaprabhā ..
dṛṣṭvā jagatprasūṃ śāntāṃ tāṃ tuṣṭāva purandaraḥ .. 2.39.50 ..
2.39.d:
बिभ्रती रत्नमालां च कोटि चन्द्रसमप्रभा ॥
दृष्ट्वा जगत्प्रसूं शान्तां तां तुष्टाव पुरन्दरः ॥ 2.39.50 ॥
2.39.m:
Wearing a jewelled necklace, endowed with the splendour of ten million moons—
Beholding that tranquil mother of the universe, Purandara praised her. (50)

2.39.s:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ..
brahmaṇā ca pradattena stotrarājena saṃyataḥ ..
sarvābhīṣṭapradenaiva vaidikenaiva tatra ca .. 51 ..
2.39.d:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गः साश्रुनेत्रः कृताञ्जलिः ॥
ब्रह्मणा च प्रदत्तेन स्तोत्रराजेन संयतः ॥
सर्वाभीष्टप्रदेनैव वैदिकेनैव तत्र च ॥ 51 ॥
2.39.m:
All his limbs bristling with joy, with tears in his eyes, having folded his hands,
Self-restrained, using the king of hymns of praise given by Brahmā,
Which grants all desires and is Vedic, [he praised her] there. (51)

2.39.s:
indra uvāca ..
oṃ namaḥ kamalavāsinyai nārāyaṇyai namo namaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapriyāyai sārāyai padmāyai ca namo namaḥ .. 52 ..
2.39.d:
इन्द्र उवाच ॥
ओं नमः कमलवासिन्यै नारायण्यै नमो नमः ॥
कृष्णप्रियायै सारायै पद्मायै च नमो नमः ॥ 52 ॥
2.39.m:
Om, salutations to her who dwells in the lotus; salutations, salutations to Nārāyaṇī!
Salutations, salutations to the beloved of Kṛṣṇa, to the essence, and to Padmā! (52)

2.39.s:
padmapatrekṣaṇāyai ca padmāsyāyai namo namaḥ ..
padmāsanāyai padminyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo namaḥ .. 53 ..
2.39.d:
पद्मपत्रेक्षणायै च पद्मास्यायै नमो नमः ॥
पद्मासनायै पद्मिन्यै वैष्णव्यै च नमो नमः ॥ 53 ॥
2.39.m:
Salutations, salutations to her whose eyes are like lotus petals, whose face is like a lotus!
Salutations, salutations to her seated on a lotus, to Padminī, and to Vaiṣṇavī! (53)

2.39.s:
sarvasampatsvarūpāyai sarvadātryai namo namaḥ ..
sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai siddhidāyai namo namaḥ .. 54 ..
2.39.d:
सर्वसम्पत्स्वरूपायै सर्वदात्र्यै नमो नमः ॥
सुखदायै मोक्षदायै सिद्धिदायै नमो नमः ॥ 54 ॥
2.39.m:
Salutations, salutations to the embodiment of all wealth, the giver of everything!
Salutations, salutations to the giver of happiness, the giver of liberation, the giver of perfection! (54)

2.39.s:
haribhaktipradātryai ca harṣadātryai namo namaḥ ..
kṛṣṇavakṣasthitāyai ca kṛṣṇeśāyai namo namaḥ .. 55 ..
2.39.d:
हरिभक्तिप्रदात्र्यै च हर्षदात्र्यै नमो नमः ॥
कृष्णवक्षस्थितायै च कृष्णेशायै नमो नमः ॥ 55 ॥
2.39.m:
Salutations, salutations to the bestower of devotion to Hari, the bestower of joy!
Salutations, salutations to her who rests on the chest of Kṛṣṇa, to Kṛṣṇā! (55)

2.39.s:
kṛṣṇaśobhāsvarū pāyai ratnāḍhyāyai namo namaḥ ..
sampattyadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai mahādevyai namo namaḥ .. 56 ..
2.39.d:
कृष्णशोभास्वरू पायै रत्नाढ्यायै नमो नमः ॥
सम्पत्त्यधिष्ठातृदेव्यै महादेव्यै नमो नमः ॥ 56 ॥
2.39.m:
Salutations, salutations to the very form of Kṛṣṇa’s beauty, rich with jewels!
Salutations, salutations to the presiding goddess of prosperity, the great goddess! (56)

2.39.s:
sasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sasyalakṣmyai namo namaḥ ..
namo buddhisvarūpāyai buddhidāyai namo namaḥ .. 57 ..
2.39.d:
सस्याधिष्ठातृदेव्यै च सस्यलक्ष्म्यै नमो नमः ॥
नमो बुद्धिस्वरूपायै बुद्धिदायै नमो नमः ॥ 57 ॥
2.39.m:
Salutations, salutations to the presiding goddess of crops, to Sasyalakṣmī!
Salutations to the embodiment of intellect; salutations, salutations to the giver of intellect! (57)

2.39.s:
vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ kṣīrodasāgare ..
svargalakṣmīrindragehe rājalakṣmīrnṛpālaye .. 58 ..
2.39.d:
वैकुण्ठे च महालक्ष्मीर्लक्ष्मीः क्षीरोदसागरे ॥
स्वर्गलक्ष्मीरिन्द्रगेहे राजलक्ष्मीर्नृपालये ॥ 58 ॥
2.39.m:
You are Mahālakṣmī in Vaikuṇṭha, Lakṣmī in the ocean of milk,
Svargalakṣmī in the house of Indra, and Rājalakṣmī in the palace of kings; (58)

2.39.s:
gṛhalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ gehe ca gṛhadevatā ..
surabhissā gavāṃ mātā dakṣiṇā yajñakāminī .. 59 ..
2.39.d:
गृहलक्ष्मीश्च गृहिणां गेहे च गृहदेवता ॥
सुरभिस्सा गवां माता दक्षिणा यज्ञकामिनी ॥ 59 ॥
2.39.m:
Gṛhalakṣmī of householders, and the household deity in the home.
[You are] Surabhi, the mother of cattle; Dakṣiṇā, beloved of sacrifice;

2.39.s:
aditirdevamātā tvaṃ kamalā kamalālaye ..
svāhā tvaṃ ca havirdāne kavyadāne svadhā smṛtā .. 2.39.60 ..
2.39.d:
अदितिर्देवमाता त्वं कमला कमलालये ॥
स्वाहा त्वं च हविर्दाने कव्यदाने स्वधा स्मृता ॥ 2.39.60 ॥
2.39.m:
you are Aditi, mother of the gods; Kamalā in her abode of lotuses;
you are Svāhā in offering oblations to the gods, and known as Svadhā in offering oblations to the ancestors.

2.39.s:
tvaṃ hi viṣṇusvarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasundharā ..
śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā..61..
2.39.d:
त्वं हि विष्णुस्वरूपा च सर्वाधारा वसुन्धरा ॥
शुद्धसत्त्वस्वरूपा त्वं नारायणपरायणा॥61॥
2.39.m:
For you are the embodiment of Viṣṇu, the earth who supports all;
your nature is pure sattva, wholly devoted to Nārāyaṇa;

2.39.s:
krodhahiṃsāvarjitā ca varadā ca śubhānanā..
paramārthapradā tvaṃ ca haridāsyapradā parā..62..
2.39.d:
क्रोधहिंसावर्जिता च वरदा च शुभानना॥
परमार्थप्रदा त्वं च हरिदास्यप्रदा परा॥62॥
2.39.m:
free from anger and violence, bestower of boons, auspicious-faced;
bestower of the supreme truth, and supreme granter of service to Hari.

2.39.s:
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ bhasmībhūtamasārakam ..
jīvanmṛtaṃ ca viśvaṃ ca śavatulyaṃ yayā vinā .. 63 ..
2.39.d:
यया विना जगत्सर्वं भस्मीभूतमसारकम् ॥
जीवन्मृतं च विश्वं च शवतुल्यं यया विना ॥ 63 ॥
2.39.m:
Without whom the entire universe is reduced to ashes, devoid of substance;
and without whom the universe is dead while living, equal to a corpse.

2.39.s:
sarveṣāṃ ca parā tvaṃ hi sarvabāndhavarūpiṇī..
yayā vinā na saṃbhāṣyo bāndhavairbāndhavaḥ sadā..64..
2.39.d:
सर्वेषां च परा त्वं हि सर्वबान्धवरूपिणी॥
यया विना न संभाष्यो बान्धवैर्बान्धवः सदा॥64॥
2.39.m:
For you are supreme over all, having the form of all kinsmen;
without whom a kinsman is never even spoken to by kinsmen.

2.39.s:
tvayā hīno bandhuhīnastvayā yuktaḥ sabāndhavaḥ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī..65..
2.39.d:
त्वया हीनो बन्धुहीनस्त्वया युक्तः सबान्धवः॥
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां त्वं च कारणरूपिणी॥65॥
2.39.m:
Bereft of you, one is bereft of friends; endowed with you, one is surrounded by friends.
And you are the cause of dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation.

2.39.s:
stanandhayānāṃ tvaṃ mātā śiśūnāṃ śaiśave yathā..
tathā tvaṃ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṃ sarvaviśvataḥ ..66..
2.39.d:
स्तनन्धयानां त्वं माता शिशूनां शैशवे यथा॥
तथा त्वं सर्वदा माता सर्वेषां सर्वविश्वतः ॥66॥
2.39.m:
Just as you are the mother of infants nursing at the breast in their infancy,
so are you the eternal mother of all beings everywhere in the universe.

2.39.s:
tyaktastano mātṛhīnaḥ sa cejjīvati daivataḥ ..
tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvatyeva niścitam .. 67 ..
2.39.d:
त्यक्तस्तनो मातृहीनः स चेज्जीवति दैवतः ॥
त्वया हीनो जनः कोऽपि न जीवत्येव निश्चितम् ॥ 67 ॥
2.39.m:
If an infant, weaned from the breast and bereft of its mother, might live by fate,
no person at all, bereft of you, ever lives—this is certain.

2.39.s:
suprasannasvarūpā tvaṃ me prasannā bhavāmbike ..
vairigrahastadviṣayaṃ dehi mahyaṃ sanātani .. 68 ..
2.39.d:
सुप्रसन्नस्वरूपा त्वं मे प्रसन्ना भवाम्बिके ॥
वैरिग्रहस्तद्विषयं देहि मह्यं सनातनि ॥ 68 ॥
2.39.m:
Your very nature is exceedingly gracious; be gracious to me, O mother!
Grant me the realm seized by enemies, O eternal one!

2.39.s:
vayaṃ yāvattvayā hīnā bandhuhīnāśca bhikṣukāḥ ..
sarvasaṃpadvihīnāśca tāvadeva haripriye ..69..
2.39.d:
वयं यावत्त्वया हीना बन्धुहीनाश्च भिक्षुकाः ॥
सर्वसंपद्विहीनाश्च तावदेव हरिप्रिये ॥69॥
2.39.m:
Only so long as we are bereft of you are we friendless, beggars,
and bereft of all prosperity, O beloved of Hari!

2.39.s:
rājyaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi balaṃ dehi sureśvari ..
kīrtiṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi putrānmahyaṃ ca dehi vai ..2.39.70..
2.39.d:
राज्यं देहि श्रियं देहि बलं देहि सुरेश्वरि ॥
कीर्तिं देहि धनं देहि पुत्रान्मह्यं च देहि वै ॥2.39.70॥
2.39.m:
Grant kingdom, grant prosperity, grant strength, O sovereign of the gods!
Grant fame, grant wealth, and indeed grant sons to me!

2.39.s:
kāmaṃ dehi matiṃ dehi bhogāndehi haripriye ..
jñānaṃ dehi ca dharmaṃ ca sarvasaubhāgyamīpsitam ..71..
2.39.d:
कामं देहि मतिं देहि भोगान्देहि हरिप्रिये ॥
ज्ञानं देहि च धर्मं च सर्वसौभाग्यमीप्सितम् ॥71॥
2.39.m:
Grant desire, grant intellect, grant enjoyments, O beloved of Hari!
Grant knowledge, and dharma, and all desired good fortune,

2.39.s:
sarvādhikāramevaṃ vai prabhāvaṃ ca pratāpakam ..
jayaṃ parākramaṃ yuddhe paramaiśvaryyameva ca..72..
2.39.d:
सर्वाधिकारमेवं वै प्रभावं च प्रतापकम् ॥
जयं पराक्रमं युद्धे परमैश्वर्य्यमेव च॥72॥
2.39.m:
and indeed sovereign authority over all, majesty, and splendour,
victory and prowess in battle, and supreme sovereignty!"

2.39.s:
ityuktvā tu mahendraśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha ..
nanāma sāśrunetro'yaṃ mūrdhnā caiva punaḥ punaḥ ..73..
2.39.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तु महेन्द्रश्च सर्वैः सुरगणैः सह ॥
ननाम साश्रुनेत्रोऽयं मूर्ध्ना चैव पुनः पुनः ॥73॥
2.39.m:
Having spoken thus, Mahendra, together with all the hosts of gods,
with tearful eyes, bowed with his head again and again.

2.39.s:
brahmā ca śaṃkaraścaiva śeṣo dharmaśca keśavaḥ..
sarve cakruḥ parīhāraṃ surārthe ca punaḥ punaḥ..74..
2.39.d:
ब्रह्मा च शंकरश्चैव शेषो धर्मश्च केशवः॥
सर्वे चक्रुः परीहारं सुरार्थे च पुनः पुनः॥74॥
2.39.m:
Brahmā and Śaṅkara, Śeṣa, Dharma, and Keśava—
all made entreaties again and again for the sake of the gods.

2.39.s:
devebhyaśca varaṃ dattvā puṣpamālāṃ manoharām..
keśavāya dadau lakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā surasaṃsadi .. 75 ..
2.39.d:
देवेभ्यश्च वरं दत्त्वा पुष्पमालां मनोहराम्॥
केशवाय ददौ लक्ष्मीः सन्तुष्टा सुरसंसदि ॥ 75 ॥
2.39.m:
Having granted a boon to the gods, Lakṣmī, delighted in the assembly of the gods,
gave an enchanting garland of flowers to Keśava.

2.39.s:
yayurdevāśca santuṣṭāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ ca nārada ..
devī yayau hareḥ kroḍaṃ hṛṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ ..76..
2.39.d:
ययुर्देवाश्च सन्तुष्टाः स्वं स्वं स्थानं च नारद ॥
देवी ययौ हरेः क्रोडं हृष्टा क्षीरोदशायिनः ॥76॥
2.39.m:
And the delighted gods went to their respective abodes, O Nārada;
the goddess, overjoyed, went to the lap of Hari who lies on the milk ocean.

2.39.s:
yayatustau svasvagṛhaṃ brahmeśānau ca nārada ..
dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau ca devebhyaḥ prītipūrvakam ..77..
2.39.d:
ययतुस्तौ स्वस्वगृहं ब्रह्मेशानौ च नारद ॥
दत्त्वा शुभाशिषं तौ च देवेभ्यः प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥77॥
2.39.m:
Both Brahmā and Īśāna went to their respective homes, O Nārada,
having bestowed auspicious blessings upon the gods with love.

2.39.s:
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..
kuberatulyaḥ sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān .. 78 ..
2.39.d:
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ॥
कुबेरतुल्यः स भवेद्राजराजेश्वरो महान् ॥ 78 ॥
2.39.m:
Whatever person recites this exceedingly meritorious hymn of praise at the three junctures of the day
shall become equal to Kubera, a great lord of king of kings.

2.39.s:
siddhastotraṃ yadi paṭhetso'pi kalpatarurnaraḥ ..
pañcalakṣa japenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām .. 79 ..
2.39.d:
सिद्धस्तोत्रं यदि पठेत्सोऽपि कल्पतरुर्नरः ॥
पञ्चलक्ष जपेनैव स्तोत्रसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम् ॥ 79 ॥
2.39.m:
If a man recites this hymn of praise once mastered, he too becomes a wish-fulfilling tree;
by five hundred thousand recitations, mastery of the hymn of praise occurs for men.

2.39.s:
siddhiḥstotraṃ yadi paṭhenmāsamekaṃ ca saṃyataḥ ..
mahāsukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 2.39.80 ..
2.39.d:
सिद्धिःस्तोत्रं यदि पठेन्मासमेकं च संयतः ॥
महासुखी च राजेन्द्रो भविष्यति न संशयः ॥ 2.39.80 ॥
2.39.m:
If with self-restraint he recites the mastered hymn of praise for one month,
he will become a great and happy emperor; of this there is no doubt.

2.39.s:
nārada uvāca ..
puṣpaṃ durvāsasā dattamasti vai yasya mastake ..
tasya sarvā puraḥpūjetyuktaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā prabho .. 81..
2.39.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
पुष्पं दुर्वाससा दत्तमस्ति वै यस्य मस्तके ॥
तस्य सर्वा पुरःपूजेत्युक्तं पूर्वं त्वया प्रभो ॥ 81॥
2.39.m:
"O Lord, it was previously said by you that whoever has on his head
the flower given by Durvāsas receives prior worship from all.

2.39.s:
tadeva sthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ gajendrasyaiva mastake ..
yato janma gaṇeśasya sa ca matto vanaṃ gataḥ .. 82 ..
2.39.d:
तदेव स्थापितं पुष्पं गजेन्द्रस्यैव मस्तके ॥
यतो जन्म गणेशस्य स च मत्तो वनं गतः ॥ 82 ॥
2.39.m:
That very flower was placed upon the head of the lord of elephants,
from whom Gaṇeśa was born, and that [elephant], intoxicated, went to the forest.

2.39.s:
mūrdhni cchinne gaṇapateḥ śanerdṛṣṭyā purā mune ..
tatskandhe yojayāmāsa hastimastaṃ hariḥ svayam ..83..
2.39.d:
मूर्ध्नि च्छिन्ने गणपतेः शनेर्दृष्ट्या पुरा मुने ॥
तत्स्कन्धे योजयामास हस्तिमस्तं हरिः स्वयम् ॥83॥
2.39.m:
When Gaṇapati's head was severed long ago by the gaze of Śani, O sage,
Hari himself joined that elephant's head to his shoulders.

2.39.s:
adhunoktaṃ devaṣaṭkaṃ saṃpūjya ca purandaraḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa lakṣmīṃ ca kṣīrode ca suraiḥ saha .. 84 ..
2.39.d:
अधुनोक्तं देवषट्कं संपूज्य च पुरन्दरः ॥
पूजयामास लक्ष्मीं च क्षीरोदे च सुरैः सह ॥ 84 ॥
2.39.m:
Now it is said that Purandara, having worshipped the group of six deities,
worshipped Lakṣmī at the milk ocean together with the gods.

2.39.s:
aho purāṇavaktṝṇāṃ durbodhaṃ vacanaṃ nṛṇām ..
suvyaktamasya siddhāntaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 85 ..
2.39.d:
अहो पुराणवक्तॄणां दुर्बोधं वचनं नृणाम् ॥
सुव्यक्तमस्य सिद्धान्तं वद वेदविदां वर ॥ 85 ॥
2.39.m:
Ah, the words of the narrators of the Purāṇas are hard for mortals to comprehend!
State the settled doctrine of this clearly, O best among knowers of the Veda!"

2.39.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
yadā śaśāpa śakraṃ ca durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ ..
tadā nāstyeva tajjanma pūjākāle babhūva saḥ ..86..
2.39.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
यदा शशाप शक्रं च दुर्वासा मुनिपुंगवः ॥
तदा नास्त्येव तज्जन्म पूजाकाले बभूव सः ॥86॥
2.39.m:
"When Durvāsas, the bull among sages, cursed Śakra,
his birth had not yet occurred; he came into being at the time of worship.

2.39.s:
suciraṃ duḥkhitā devā babhramurbrahmaśāpataḥ..
paścātprāpuśca tāṃ lakṣmīṃ vareṇa ca harermune..87..
śrīlakṣmyupākhyānaṃ samāptam ..
2.39.d:
सुचिरं दुःखिता देवा बभ्रमुर्ब्रह्मशापतः॥
पश्चात्प्रापुश्च तां लक्ष्मीं वरेण च हरेर्मुने॥87॥
श्रीलक्ष्म्युपाख्यानं समाप्तम् ॥

2.40.s:
nārada uvāca..
nārāyaṇa mahābhāga samaścaiva tvayā prabho..
rūpeṇa ca guṇaiścaiva yaśasā tejasā tviṣā..1..
2.40.d:
नारद उवाच॥
नारायण महाभाग समश्चैव त्वया प्रभो॥
रूपेण च गुणैश्चैव यशसा तेजसा त्विषा॥1॥

2.40.s:
tvameva jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā..
tapasvināṃ munīnāṃ ca paro vedavidāṃ tathā..
mahālakṣmyā upākhyānaṃ vijñātaṃ mahadadbhutam ..2..
2.40.d:
त्वमेव ज्ञानिनां श्रेष्ठः सिद्धानां योगिनां तथा॥
तपस्विनां मुनीनां च परो वेदविदां तथा॥
महालक्ष्म्या उपाख्यानं विज्ञातं महदद्भुतम् ॥2॥

2.40.s:
anyatkiñcidupākhyānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vada sāmpratam..
atīva gopanīyaṃ yadupayuktaṃ ca sarvataḥ..
aprakāśyaṃ purāṇeṣu vedoktaṃ dharmasaṃyutam..3..
2.40.d:
अन्यत्किञ्चिदुपाख्यानं निगूढं वद साम्प्रतम्॥
अतीव गोपनीयं यदुपयुक्तं च सर्वतः॥
अप्रकाश्यं पुराणेषु वेदोक्तं धर्मसंयुतम्॥3॥

2.40.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca..
nānāprakāramākhyānamaprakāśyaṃ purāṇataḥ ..
śrutau katividhaṃ gūḍhamāste brahmansudurlabham.. 4 ..
2.40.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच॥
नानाप्रकारमाख्यानमप्रकाश्यं पुराणतः ॥
श्रुतौ कतिविधं गूढमास्ते ब्रह्मन्सुदुर्लभम्॥ 4 ॥

2.40.s:
teṣu yatsārabhūtaṃ ca śrotuṃ kiṃvā tvamicchasi ..
tanme brūhi mahābhāga paścādvakṣyāmi tatpunaḥ ..5..
2.40.d:
तेषु यत्सारभूतं च श्रोतुं किंवा त्वमिच्छसि ॥
तन्मे ब्रूहि महाभाग पश्चाद्वक्ष्यामि तत्पुनः ॥5॥

2.40.s:
nārada uvāca ..
svāhā devahavirdāne praśastā sarvakarmasu..
pitṛdāne svadhā śastā dakṣiṇā sarvato varā ..6..
2.40.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
स्वाहा देवहविर्दाने प्रशस्ता सर्वकर्मसु॥
पितृदाने स्वधा शस्ता दक्षिणा सर्वतो वरा ॥6॥

2.40.s:
etāsāṃ caritaṃ janma phalaṃ prādhānyameva ca ..
śrotumicchāmi te vaktrādvada vedavidāṃ vara .. 7 ..
2.40.d:
एतासां चरितं जन्म फलं प्राधान्यमेव च ॥
श्रोतुमिच्छामि ते वक्त्राद्वद वेदविदां वर ॥ 7 ॥

2.40.s:
sautiruvāca ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe purāṇoktāṃ purātanīm .. 8 ..
2.40.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुंगवः ॥
कथां कथितुमारेभे पुराणोक्तां पुरातनीम् ॥ 8 ॥

2.40.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
sṛṣṭeḥ prathamato devāścāhārārthaṃ yayuḥ purā ..
brahmaloke brahmasabhāmagamyāṃ sumanoharām .. 9 ..
2.40.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
सृष्टेः प्रथमतो देवाश्चाहारार्थं ययुः पुरा ॥
ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्मसभामगम्यां सुमनोहराम् ॥ 9 ॥

2.40.s:
gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurmune tvāhārahetukam ..
brahmā śrutvā pratijñāya siṣeve śrīhareḥ padam .. 2.40.10 ..
2.40.d:
गत्वा निवेदनं चक्रुर्मुने त्वाहारहेतुकम् ॥
ब्रह्मा श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञाय सिषेवे श्रीहरेः पदम् ॥ 2.40.10 ॥

2.40.s:
yajñarūpo hi bhagavānkalayā ca babhūva saḥ ..
yajñe yadyaddhavirdānaṃ dattaṃ tebhyaśca vedhasā .. 11 ..
2.40.d:
यज्ञरूपो हि भगवान्कलया च बभूव सः ॥
यज्ञे यद्यद्धविर्दानं दत्तं तेभ्यश्च वेधसा ॥ 11 ॥

2.40.s:
havirdadati viprāśca bhaktyā ca kṣatriyādayaḥ ..
surā naiva prāpnuvanti taddānaṃ munipuṃgava .. 12 ..
2.40.d:
हविर्ददति विप्राश्च भक्त्या च क्षत्रियादयः ॥
सुरा नैव प्राप्नुवन्ति तद्दानं मुनिपुंगव ॥ 12 ॥

2.40.s:
devā viṣaṇṇāste sarve tatsabhāṃ ca punaryayuḥ ..
gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurāhārābhāvahetukam .. 13 ..
2.40.d:
देवा विषण्णास्ते सर्वे तत्सभां च पुनर्ययुः ॥
गत्वा निवेदनं चक्रुराहाराभावहेतुकम् ॥ 13 ॥

2.40.s:
brahmā śrutvā tu manasā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
prakṛtiṃ pūjayāmāsa dhyāyanneva tadājñayā.. .. 14 ..
2.40.d:
ब्रह्मा श्रुत्वा तु मनसा श्रीकृष्णं शरणं ययौ ॥
प्रकृतिं पूजयामास ध्यायन्नेव तदाज्ञया॥ ॥ 14 ॥

2.40.s:
prakṛtiḥ kalayā caiva sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ..
babhūva dāhikā śaktiragneḥ svāhāsvarūpiṇī .. 15 ..
2.40.d:
प्रकृतिः कलया चैव सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ॥
बभूव दाहिका शक्तिरग्नेः स्वाहास्वरूपिणी ॥ 15 ॥

2.40.s:
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍa prabhānyakkārakāriṇī ..
atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīyā manoharā .. 16 ..
2.40.d:
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्त्तण्ड प्रभान्यक्कारकारिणी ॥
अतीव सुन्दरी रामा रमणीया मनोहरा ॥ 16 ॥

2.40.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakāriṇī ..
uvāceti vidheragre padmayone varaṃ vṛṇu .. 17 ..
2.40.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्या भक्तानुग्रहकारिणी ॥
उवाचेति विधेरग्रे पद्मयोने वरं वृणु ॥ 17 ॥

2.40.s: vidhistadvacanaṃ śrutvā sambhramātsamuvāca tām .. 18 ..
2.40.d: विधिस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्भ्रमात्समुवाच ताम् ॥ 18 ॥

2.40.s:
brahmovāca ..
tvamagnerdāhikā śaktirbhava patnī ca sundarī ..
dagdhuṃ na śaktassvahutaṃ hutāśaśca tvayā vinā .. 19 ..
2.40.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
त्वमग्नेर्दाहिका शक्तिर्भव पत्नी च सुन्दरी ॥
दग्धुं न शक्तस्स्वहुतं हुताशश्च त्वया विना ॥ 19 ॥

2.40.s:
tvannāmoccāryya mantrānte yaddāsyati havirnaraḥ ..
surebhyastatprāpnuvanti surāḥ sānandapūrvakam ..2.40.20..
2.40.d:
त्वन्नामोच्चार्य्य मन्त्रान्ते यद्दास्यति हविर्नरः ॥
सुरेभ्यस्तत्प्राप्नुवन्ति सुराः सानन्दपूर्वकम् ॥2.40.20॥

2.40.s:
agneḥ sampatsvarūpā ca śrīrūpā ca gṛheśvarī ..
devānāṃ pūjitā śaśvannarādīnāṃ bhavāmbike.. .. 21 ..
2.40.d:
अग्नेः सम्पत्स्वरूपा च श्रीरूपा च गृहेश्वरी ॥
देवानां पूजिता शश्वन्नरादीनां भवाम्बिके॥ ॥ 21 ॥

2.40.s:
brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā sā viṣaṇṇā babhūva ha ..
tamuvāca svayaṃ devī svābhiprāyaṃ svayambhuvam .. 22 ..
2.40.d:
ब्रह्मणश्च वचः श्रुत्वा सा विषण्णा बभूव ह ॥
तमुवाच स्वयं देवी स्वाभिप्रायं स्वयम्भुवम् ॥ 22 ॥

2.40.s:
svāhovāca ..
ahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajiṣyāmi tapasā sucireṇa ca ..
brahmaṃstadanyadyatkiṃcitsvapnavadbhrama eva ca ..23 ..
2.40.d:
स्वाहोवाच ॥
अहं कृष्णं भजिष्यामि तपसा सुचिरेण च ॥
ब्रह्मंस्तदन्यद्यत्किंचित्स्वप्नवद्भ्रम एव च ॥23 ॥

2.40.s:
vidhātā jagatāṃ tvaṃ ca śambhurmṛtyuñjayaḥ prabhuḥ ..
bibharti śeṣo viśvaṃ ca dharmmaḥ sākṣī ca dehinām .. 24 ..
2.40.d:
विधाता जगतां त्वं च शम्भुर्मृत्युञ्जयः प्रभुः ॥
बिभर्ति शेषो विश्वं च धर्म्मः साक्षी च देहिनाम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.40.m: Śeṣa supports the universe, and Dharma is the witness of embodied beings; / 24

2.40.s:
sarvādyapūjyo devānāṃ gaṇeṣu ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
prakṛtiḥ sarvasūḥ sarve pūjitā yatprasādataḥ ..25..
2.40.d:
सर्वाद्यपूज्यो देवानां गणेषु च गणेश्वरः ॥
प्रकृतिः सर्वसूः सर्वे पूजिता यत्प्रसादतः ॥25॥
2.40.m:
Gaṇeśvara is worthy of worship before all gods and hosts;
Prakṛti is the mother of all—all these are worshipped by his grace. / 25

2.40.s:
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva pūjitā yaṃ niṣevya ca ..
tatpādapadmaṃ brahmaikyabhāvādvai cintayāmyaham ..26..
2.40.d:
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव पूजिता यं निषेव्य च ॥
तत्पादपद्मं ब्रह्मैक्यभावाद्वै चिन्तयाम्यहम् ॥26॥
2.40.m:
Having served him, the seers and sages are also worshipped.
I meditate on His lotus feet through a state of oneness with Brahman.

2.40.s:
padmāsyā pādmamityuktvā padmalābhānusārataḥ ..
jagāma tapase pādme padmādīśasya padmajā .. 27 ..
2.40.d:
पद्मास्या पाद्ममित्युक्त्वा पद्मलाभानुसारतः ॥
जगाम तपसे पाद्मे पद्मादीशस्य पद्मजा ॥ 27 ॥
2.40.m:
Having spoken this, the lotus-faced daughter, born of Brahmā, according to the attainment of the lotus [of Brahman],
went in the Pādma [Kalpa] to perform tapas towards the Lord of lotus-born Brahmā.

2.40.s:
tapastepe lakṣavarṣamekapādena pādmajā ..
tadā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param .. 28 ..
2.40.d:
तपस्तेपे लक्षवर्षमेकपादेन पाद्मजा ॥
तदा ददर्श श्रीकृष्णं निर्गुणं प्रकृतेः परम् ॥ 28 ॥
2.40.m:
The daughter born of Brahmā performed tapas on one foot for a hundred thousand years.
Then she saw Śrī Kṛṣṇa, beyond the gunas, higher than Prakṛti.

2.40.s:
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sundarī ..
mūrchāṃ samprāpa kāmena kāmeśasya ca kāmukī .. 29 ..
2.40.d:
अतीव कमनीयं च रूपं दृष्ट्वा च सुन्दरी ॥
मूर्छां सम्प्राप कामेन कामेशस्य च कामुकी ॥ 29 ॥
2.40.m:
And seeing his exceedingly desirable form, the beautiful woman,
longing for the Lord of desire, fell into a faint through desire.

2.40.s:
vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñastāmuvāca saḥ ..
svakroḍe ca samutthāpya kṣīṇāṃgīṃ tapasā ciram .. 2.40.30 ..
2.40.d:
विज्ञाय तदभिप्रायं सर्वज्ञस्तामुवाच सः ॥
स्वक्रोडे च समुत्थाप्य क्षीणांगीं तपसा चिरम् ॥ 2.40.30 ॥
2.40.m:
Knowing her intention, the omniscient Lord said to her,
lifting onto his lap her whose limbs were emaciated by long tapas.

2.40.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
vārāhe ca tvamaṃśena mama patnī bhaviṣyasi ..
nāmnā nāgnajitī kanyā kānte nagnajitasya ca .. 31 ..
2.40.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
वाराहे च त्वमंशेन मम पत्नी भविष्यसि ॥
नाम्ना नाग्नजिती कन्या कान्ते नग्नजितस्य च ॥ 31 ॥
2.40.m:
In the Vārāha [Kalpa], you will become my wife by a portion [of yourself],
by name Nāgnajitī, the beloved daughter of Nagnajit.

2.40.s:
adhunā'gnerdāhikā tvaṃ bhava patnī ca bhāvini ..
mantrāṅgarūpā pūtā ca matprasādādbhaviṣyasi .. 32 ..
2.40.d:
अधुनाऽग्नेर्दाहिका त्वं भव पत्नी च भाविनि ॥
मन्त्राङ्गरूपा पूता च मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि ॥ 32 ॥
2.40.m:
Now, noble lady, become the burning power and the wife of Agni.
You will become an integral part of mantras, purified by my grace.

2.40.s:
vahnistvāṃ bhaktibhāvena sampūjya ca gṛheśvarīm..
ramiṣyate tvayā sārddhaṃ rāmayā ramaṇīyayā .. 33 ..
2.40.d:
वह्निस्त्वां भक्तिभावेन सम्पूज्य च गृहेश्वरीम्॥
रमिष्यते त्वया सार्द्धं रामया रमणीयया ॥ 33 ॥
2.40.m:
Worshipping you with devotion as the mistress of his house,
Vahni will delight with you, a lovely, delightful woman.

2.40.s:
ityuktvā'ntardadhe devo devīmāśvāsya nārada ..
tatrājagāma santrasto vahnirbrahmanideśataḥ .. 34 ..
2.40.d:
इत्युक्त्वाऽन्तर्दधे देवो देवीमाश्वास्य नारद ॥
तत्राजगाम सन्त्रस्तो वह्निर्ब्रह्मनिदेशतः ॥ 34 ॥
2.40.m:
Having spoken thus and comforted the goddess, O Nārada, the god vanished.
Trembling with awe, Vahni went there by the command of Brahmā.

2.40.s:
dhyānaiśca sāmavedoktairdhyātvā tāṃ jagadambikām ..
sampūjya parituṣṭāva pāṇiṃ jagrāha mantrataḥ .. 35 ..
2.40.d:
ध्यानैश्च सामवेदोक्तैर्ध्यात्वा तां जगदम्बिकाम् ॥
सम्पूज्य परितुष्टाव पाणिं जग्राह मन्त्रतः ॥ 35 ॥
2.40.m:
Having meditated on that Mother of the Universe with the meditations spoken in the Sāmaveda,
and having worshipped and praised her, he took her hand according to the mantra.

2.40.s:
tadā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sa reme rāmayā saha ..
atīva nirjane ramye sambhogasukhade sadā ..36..
2.40.d:
तदा दिव्यं वर्षशतं स रेमे रामया सह ॥
अतीव निर्जने रम्ये सम्भोगसुखदे सदा ॥36॥
2.40.m:
Then he delighted with the woman for a hundred divine years
in an exceedingly solitary, charming [place] that always bestowed the pleasure of union.

2.40.s:
babhūva garbhaṃ tasyāśca hutāśasyaiva tejasā ..
taddadhāra ca sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram .. 37 ..
2.40.d:
बभूव गर्भं तस्याश्च हुताशस्यैव तेजसा ॥
तद्दधार च सा देवी दिव्यं द्वादशवत्सरम् ॥ 37 ॥
2.40.m:
And conception took place in her through the splendour of Hutāśa;
and that goddess bore it for twelve divine years.

2.40.s:
tataḥ suṣāva putrāṃśca ramaṇīyānmanoharān ..
dakṣiṇāgnirgārhapatyāhavanīyānkrameṇa ca .. .. 38 ..
2.40.d:
ततः सुषाव पुत्रांश्च रमणीयान्मनोहरान् ॥
दक्षिणाग्निर्गार्हपत्याहवनीयान्क्रमेण च ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
2.40.m:
Then she gave birth to delightful, captivating sons,
namely Dakṣiṇāgni, Gārhapatya, and Āhavanīya in succession.

2.40.s:
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ ..
svāhāntaṃ mantramuccāryya havirdadati nityaśaḥ .. 39 ..
2.40.d:
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियादयः ॥
स्वाहान्तं मन्त्रमुच्चार्य्य हविर्ददति नित्यशः ॥ 39 ॥
2.40.m:
Rṣis, munis, brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, and the rest,
constantly offer oblations uttering the mantra ending with 'Svāhā'.

2.40.s:
svāhāyuktaṃ ca mantraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti praśastakam ..
sarvasiddhirbhavettasya brahmangrahaṇamātrataḥ .. 2.40.40 ..
2.40.d:
स्वाहायुक्तं च मन्त्रं च यो गृह्णाति प्रशस्तकम् ॥
सर्वसिद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य ब्रह्मन्ग्रहणमात्रतः ॥ 2.40.40 ॥
2.40.m:
Whoever receives an auspicious mantra accompanied by 'Svāhā',
all accomplishments come to him, O brahmin, merely by receiving it.

2.40.s:
viṣahīno yathā sarpo vedahīno yathā dvijaḥ ..
patisevāvihīnā strī vidyāhīno yathā naraḥ .. 41 ..
2.40.d:
विषहीनो यथा सर्पो वेदहीनो यथा द्विजः ॥
पतिसेवाविहीना स्त्री विद्याहीनो यथा नरः ॥ 41 ॥
2.40.m:
Just as a snake without poison, just as a twice-born without the Vedas,
a woman without service to her husband, just as a man without learning,

2.40.s:
phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo hi ninditaḥ ..
svāhāhīnastathā mantro na drutaṃ phaladāyakaḥ .. 42 ..
2.40.d:
फलशाखाविहीनश्च यथा वृक्षो हि निन्दितः ॥
स्वाहाहीनस्तथा मन्त्रो न द्रुतं फलदायकः ॥ 42 ॥
2.40.m:
and just as a tree destitute of fruits and branches is indeed despised,
so a mantra devoid of 'Svāhā' does not quickly yield fruit.

2.40.s:
parituṣṭā dvijāḥ sarve devāḥ saṃprāpurāhutim ..
svāhāntenaiva mantreṇa saphalaṃ sarvakarma ca .. 43 ..
2.40.d:
परितुष्टा द्विजाः सर्वे देवाः संप्रापुराहुतिम् ॥
स्वाहान्तेनैव मन्त्रेण सफलं सर्वकर्म च ॥ 43 ॥
2.40.m:
All the twice-born were satisfied, and the gods received their oblation;
and through the mantra ending with 'Svāhā', every ritual action is fruitful.

2.40.s:
ityevaṃ varṇitaṃ sarvaṃ svāhopākhyānamuttamam ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ ki bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 44 ..
2.40.d:
इत्येवं वर्णितं सर्वं स्वाहोपाख्यानमुत्तमम् ॥
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं कि भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 44 ॥
2.40.m:
Thus the entire excellent Svāhā episode has been narrated,
giving happiness, granting liberation, the essence [of truth]. What more do you wish to hear?

2.40.s:
nārada uvāca ..
svāhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ munīśvara ..
saṃpūjya vahnistuṣṭāva yena tāṃ vada me prabho .. 45 ..
2.40.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
स्वाहापूजाविधानं च ध्यानं स्तोत्रं मुनीश्वर ॥
संपूज्य वह्निस्तुष्टाव येन तां वद मे प्रभो ॥ 45 ॥
2.40.m:
The ritual of Svāhā's worship, the meditation, and the hymn of praise, O lord of munis,
by which Vahni praised her after worshipping her—tell me that, O lord!

2.40.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhānakam ..
vadāmi śrūyatāṃ brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya .. 46 ..
2.40.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं स्तोत्रं पूजाविधानकम् ॥
वदामि श्रूयतां ब्रह्मन्सावधानं निशामय ॥ 46 ॥
2.40.m:
The meditation spoken in the Sāmaveda, the hymn of praise, and the ritual of worship,
I tell you; let it be heard, O brahmin; listen attentively.

2.40.s:
sarvayajñārambhakāle śālagrāme ghaṭe'thavā ..
svāhāṃ saṃpūjya yatnena yajñaṃ kuryyātphalāptaye .. 47 ..
2.40.d:
सर्वयज्ञारम्भकाले शालग्रामे घटेऽथवा ॥
स्वाहां संपूज्य यत्नेन यज्ञं कुर्य्यात्फलाप्तये ॥ 47 ॥
2.40.m:
At the beginning of every sacrifice, upon a Śāligrāma or a water-pot,
having worshipped Svāhā with care, one should perform the sacrifice to obtain its fruit:

2.40.s:
svāhāṃ mantrāṅgabhūtāṃ ca mantrasiddhisvarūpiṇīm ..
siddhāṃ ca siddhidāṃ nṛṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje .. 48..
2.40.d:
स्वाहां मन्त्राङ्गभूतां च मन्त्रसिद्धिस्वरूपिणीम् ॥
सिद्धां च सिद्धिदां नृणां कर्मणां फलदां भजे ॥ 48॥
2.40.m:
"Svāhā, who is an integral part of mantras, whose essential form is the success of mantras,
perfected, granting success to men, bestowing the fruit of actions—her I revere."

2.40.s:
iti dhyātvā ca mūlena dattvā pādyādikaṃ naraḥ ..
sarvasiddhiṃ labhetstutvā mūlaṃ stotraṃ mune śṛṇu .. 49 ..
2.40.d:
इति ध्यात्वा च मूलेन दत्त्वा पाद्यादिकं नरः ॥
सर्वसिद्धिं लभेत्स्तुत्वा मूलं स्तोत्रं मुने शृणु ॥ 49 ॥
2.40.m:
Having thus meditated, and offering water for washing the feet and other offerings with the root mantra, a man
attains all success after praising [her]. Hear the root mantra and the hymn of praise, O sage:

2.40.s:
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vahnijāyāyai devyai svāhetyanena ca ..
yaḥ pūjayecca tāṃ devīṃ sarveṣṭaṃ labhate dhruvam .. 2.40.50 ..
2.40.d:
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं वह्निजायायै देव्यै स्वाहेत्यनेन च ॥
यः पूजयेच्च तां देवीं सर्वेष्टं लभते ध्रुवम् ॥ 2.40.50 ॥
2.40.m:
"Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ, to the goddess, the wife of Vahni, svāhā"—with this [mantra],
whoever worships that goddess certainly attains all desires.

2.40.s:
vahniruvāca ..
svāhā ''dyā prakṛteraṃśā mantratantrāṅgarūpiṇī..
mantrāṇāṃ phaladātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ satī ..51..
2.40.d:
वह्निरुवाच ॥
स्वाहा 'ऽद्या प्रकृतेरंशा मन्त्रतन्त्राङ्गरूपिणी॥
मन्त्राणां फलदात्री च धात्री च जगतां सती ॥51॥
2.40.m:
Svāhā is primordial, a portion of Prakṛti, the embodiment of a limb of mantras and tantras,
the bestower of fruit for mantras, the sustainer of the worlds, virtuous,

2.40.s:
siddhisvarūpā siddhā ca siddhidā sarvadā nṛṇām ..
hutāśadāhikāśaktistatprāṇādhikarūpiṇī .. 52 ..
2.40.d:
सिद्धिस्वरूपा सिद्धा च सिद्धिदा सर्वदा नृणाम् ॥
हुताशदाहिकाशक्तिस्तत्प्राणाधिकरूपिणी ॥ 52 ॥
2.40.m:
the embodiment of success, perfected, ever bestowing success on men,
the burning power of Hutāśa, dearer than his own life,

2.40.s:
saṃsārasārarūpā ca ghorasaṃsāratāriṇī ..
devajīvanarūpā ca devapoṣaṇakāriṇī .. 53 ..
2.40.d:
संसारसाररूपा च घोरसंसारतारिणी ॥
देवजीवनरूपा च देवपोषणकारिणी ॥ 53 ॥
2.40.m:
the essential form of the world, carrying across the terrible cycle of rebirth,
the life of the gods, and the nourisher of the gods.

2.40.s:
ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ ..
sarvasiddhirbhavettasya ceha loke paratra ca .. 54 ..
2.40.d:
षोडशैतानि नामानि यः पठेद्भक्तिसंयुतः ॥
सर्वसिद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य चेह लोके परत्र च ॥ 54 ॥
2.40.m:
Whoever recites these sixteen names filled with devotion,
he attains all perfection, both in this world and in the next.

2.40.s:
nāṅgahīno bhavettasya sarvakarmasu śobhanam ..
aputro labhate putramabhāryyo labhate priyām .. 55 ..
2.40.d:
नाङ्गहीनो भवेत्तस्य सर्वकर्मसु शोभनम् ॥
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमभार्य्यो लभते प्रियाम् ॥ 55 ॥
2.40.m:
No defect shall befall him, and there will be success in all his rites.
A childless man obtains a son; a wifeless man obtains a beloved wife.

2.41.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi svadhopākhyānamuttamam ..
pitṝṇāṃ vai tṛptikaraṃ śrāddhānāṃ phalavarddhanam .. 1 ..
2.41.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि स्वधोपाख्यानमुत्तमम् ॥
पितॄणां वै तृप्तिकरं श्राद्धानां फलवर्द्धनम् ॥ 1 ॥

2.41.s:
sṛṣṭerādau pitṛgaṇānsasarja jagatāṃ vidhiḥ ..
caturo vai mūrttimatastrīṃśca tejassvarūpiṇaḥ .. 2 ..
2.41.d:
सृष्टेरादौ पितृगणान्ससर्ज जगतां विधिः ॥
चतुरो वै मूर्त्तिमतस्त्रींश्च तेजस्स्वरूपिणः ॥ 2 ॥

2.41.s:
sapta dṛṣṭvā pitṛgaṇānsiddhirūpānmanoharān ..
āhāraṃ sasṛje teṣāṃ śrāddhatarpaṇapūrvakam.. 3 ..
2.41.d:
सप्त दृष्ट्वा पितृगणान्सिद्धिरूपान्मनोहरान् ॥
आहारं ससृजे तेषां श्राद्धतर्पणपूर्वकम्॥ 3 ॥

2.41.s:
snānaṃ tarpaṇaparyyantaṃ śrāddhāntaṃ devapūjanam ..
āhnikaṃ ca trisandhyāntaṃ viprāṇāṃ ca śrutau śrutam .. 4 ..
2.41.d:
स्नानं तर्पणपर्य्यन्तं श्राद्धान्तं देवपूजनम् ॥
आह्निकं च त्रिसन्ध्यान्तं विप्राणां च श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 4 ॥

2.41.s:
nityaṃ na kuryyādyo viprastrisandhyaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam ..
baliṃ vedadhvaniṃ so'pi viṣahīno yathoragaḥ .. 5 ..
2.41.d:
नित्यं न कुर्य्याद्यो विप्रस्त्रिसन्ध्यं श्राद्धतर्पणम् ॥
बलिं वेदध्वनिं सोऽपि विषहीनो यथोरगः ॥ 5 ॥

2.41.s:
harisevāvihīnaśca śrīhareranivedyabhuk ..
bhasmāntaṃ sūtakaṃ tasya na karmārhaḥ sa nārada .. 6 ..
2.41.d:
हरिसेवाविहीनश्च श्रीहरेरनिवेद्यभुक् ॥
भस्मान्तं सूतकं तस्य न कर्मार्हः स नारद ॥ 6 ॥

2.41.s:
brahmā śrāddhādikaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagāma pitṛhetave ..
na prāpnuvanti pitaro dadati brāhmaṇādayaḥ .. 7 ..
2.41.d:
ब्रह्मा श्राद्धादिकं सृष्ट्वा जगाम पितृहेतवे ॥
न प्राप्नुवन्ति पितरो ददति ब्राह्मणादयः ॥ 7 ॥

2.41.s:
sarve prajagmuḥ kṣudhitā viṣaṇṇā brahmaṇaḥ sabhām ..
sarve nivedanaṃ cakrustameva jagatāṃ vidhim .. .. 8 ..
2.41.d:
सर्वे प्रजग्मुः क्षुधिता विषण्णा ब्रह्मणः सभाम् ॥
सर्वे निवेदनं चक्रुस्तमेव जगतां विधिम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥

2.41.s:
brahmā ca mānasīṃ kanyāṃ sasṛje tāṃ manoharām ..
rūpayauvanasampannāṃ śaraccandrasamaprabhām .. 9 ..
2.41.d:
ब्रह्मा च मानसीं कन्यां ससृजे तां मनोहराम् ॥
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नां शरच्चन्द्रसमप्रभाम् ॥ 9 ॥

2.41.s:
vidyāvatīṃ guṇavatīmapi rūpavatīṃ satīm ..
śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 2.41.10 ..
2.41.d:
विद्यावतीं गुणवतीमपि रूपवतीं सतीम् ॥
श्वेतचम्पकवर्णाभां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ 2.41.10 ॥

2.41.s:
viśuddhāṃ prakṛteraṃśāṃ sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhām ..
svadhābhidhānāṃ sudatīṃ lakṣmīṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām .. 11 ..
2.41.d:
विशुद्धां प्रकृतेरंशां सस्मितां वरदां शुभाम् ॥
स्वधाभिधानां सुदतीं लक्ष्मीं लक्षणसंयुताम् ॥ 11 ॥

2.41.s:
śatapadmapadanyastapādapadmaṃ ca bibhratīm ..
patnīṃ pitṝṇāṃ padmāsyāṃ padmajāṃ padmalocanām .. .. 12 ..
2.41.d:
शतपद्मपदन्यस्तपादपद्मं च बिभ्रतीम् ॥
पत्नीं पितॄणां पद्मास्यां पद्मजां पद्मलोचनाम् ॥ ॥ 12 ॥

2.41.s:
pitṛbhyastāṃ dadau kanyāṃ tuṣṭebhyastuṣṭirūpiṇīm ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ copadeśaṃ cakre vai gopanīyakam .. 13 ..
2.41.d:
पितृभ्यस्तां ददौ कन्यां तुष्टेभ्यस्तुष्टिरूपिणीम् ॥
ब्राह्मणानां चोपदेशं चक्रे वै गोपनीयकम् ॥ 13 ॥

2.41.s:
svadhāntaṃ mantramuccāryya pitṛbhyo dehi ceti ca ..
krameṇa tena viprāśca pitre dānaṃ daduḥ purā .. 14 ..
2.41.d:
स्वधान्तं मन्त्रमुच्चार्य्य पितृभ्यो देहि चेति च ॥
क्रमेण तेन विप्राश्च पित्रे दानं ददुः पुरा ॥ 14 ॥

2.41.s:
svāhā śastā devadāne pitṛdāne svadhā varā ..
sarvatra dakṣiṇā śastā hato yajñastvadakṣiṇaḥ .. 15 ..
2.41.d:
स्वाहा शस्ता देवदाने पितृदाने स्वधा वरा ॥
सर्वत्र दक्षिणा शस्ता हतो यज्ञस्त्वदक्षिणः ॥ 15 ॥

2.41.s:
pitaro devatā viprā munayo mānavāstathā ..
pūjāṃ cakruḥ svadhāṃ śāntāṃ tuṣṭāva paramādaram .. 16 ..
2.41.d:
पितरो देवता विप्रा मुनयो मानवास्तथा ॥
पूजां चक्रुः स्वधां शान्तां तुष्टाव परमादरम् ॥ 16 ॥

2.41.s:
devādayaśca santuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ..
viprādayaśca pitaraḥ svadhādevīvareṇa ca .. 17 ..
2.41.d:
देवादयश्च सन्तुष्टाः परिपूर्णमनोरथाः ॥
विप्रादयश्च पितरः स्वधादेवीवरेण च ॥ 17 ॥

2.41.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svadhopākhyānamuttamam ..
sarveṣāṃ vai tuṣṭikaraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 18 ..
2.41.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं स्वधोपाख्यानमुत्तमम् ॥
सर्वेषां वै तुष्टिकरं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 18 ॥

2.41.s:
nārada uvāca ..
svadhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mahāmune ..
śrotumicchāmi yatnena vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 19 ..
2.41.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
स्वधापूजाविधानं च ध्यानं स्तोत्रं महामुने ॥
श्रोतुमिच्छामि यत्नेन वद वेदविदां वर ॥ 19 ॥

2.41.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
taddhyānaṃ stavanaṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ..
sarvaṃ jānāsi vakṣye vai jñātumicchasi vṛddhaye .. 2.41.20 ..
2.41.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
तद्ध्यानं स्तवनं ब्रह्मन्वेदोक्तं सर्वसम्मतम् ॥
सर्वं जानासि वक्ष्ये वै ज्ञातुमिच्छसि वृद्धये ॥ 2.41.20 ॥

2.41.s:
śaratkṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ maghāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ..
svadhāṃ saṃpūjya yatnena tataḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 21 ..
2.41.d:
शरत्कृष्णत्रयोदश्यां मघायां श्राद्धवासरे ॥
स्वधां संपूज्य यत्नेन ततः श्राद्धं समाचरेत् ॥ 21 ॥

2.41.s:
svadhāṃ nābhyarcya yo vipraḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryyādahaṃmatiḥ ..
na bhavetphalabhāk satyaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇayostathā .. 22 ..
2.41.d:
स्वधां नाभ्यर्च्य यो विप्रः श्राद्धं कुर्य्यादहंमतिः ॥
न भवेत्फलभाक् सत्यं श्राद्धतर्पणयोस्तथा ॥ 22 ॥

2.41.s:
brahmaṇo mānasīṃ kanyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ..
pūjyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje .. 23 ..
2.41.d:
ब्रह्मणो मानसीं कन्यां शश्वत्सुस्थिरयौवनाम् ॥
पूज्यां पितॄणां देवानां श्राद्धानां फलदां भजे ॥ 23 ॥
2.41.m: who is worthy of worship by the ancestors and gods, and who grants the fruit of śrāddha rites.”

2.41.s:
iti dhyātvā ghaṭe ramye śālagrāme'thavā śubhe ..
dadyātpādyādikaṃ tasyai mūleneti śrutau śrutam .. 24 ..
2.41.d:
इति ध्यात्वा घटे रम्ये शालग्रामेऽथवा शुभे ॥
दद्यात्पाद्यादिकं तस्यै मूलेनेति श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.41.m:
Having thus meditated, upon a charming water-jar or upon an auspicious Śāligrāma stone,
one should offer water for washing the feet and other rites to her with the root mantra, as heard in the Veda.

2.41.s:
āṃ śrīṃ klīṃ svadhādevyai svāheti ca mahāmanum ..
samuccāryya ca saṃpūjya stutvā tāṃ praṇameddvijaḥ .. 25 ..
2.41.d:
आं श्रीं क्लीं स्वधादेव्यै स्वाहेति च महामनुम् ॥
समुच्चार्य्य च संपूज्य स्तुत्वा तां प्रणमेद्द्विजः ॥ 25 ॥
2.41.m:
Having uttered the great mantra, “Āṃ Śrīṃ Klīṃ Svadhādevyai Svāhā,”
the twice-born should worship her, praise her, and bow down before her.

2.41.s:
stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha brahmaputra viśārada ..
sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nṝṇāṃ brahmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ purā..26..
2.41.d:
स्तोत्रं शृणु मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मपुत्र विशारद ॥
सर्ववाञ्छाप्रदं नॄणां ब्रह्मणा यत्कृतं पुरा॥26॥
2.41.m:
Listen, O best of sages, wise son of Brahmā, to the hymn of praise
composed of old by Brahmā, which grants every desire to men.

2.41.s:
brahmovāca ..
svadhoccāraṇamātreṇa tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 27 ..
2.41.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
स्वधोच्चारणमात्रेण तीर्थस्नायी भवेन्नरः॥
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो वाजपेयफलं लभेत् ॥ 27 ॥
2.41.m:
Merely by uttering "Svadhā", a man becomes one who has bathed at sacred shrines;
he is freed from all sins and obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice. / / 27 /

2.41.s:
svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ yadi vāratrayaṃ smaret ..
śrāddhasya phalamāpnoti kālatarpaṇayostathā .. 28 ..
2.41.d:
स्वधा स्वधा स्वधेत्येवं यदि वारत्रयं स्मरेत् ॥
श्राद्धस्य फलमाप्नोति कालतर्पणयोस्तथा ॥ 28 ॥
2.41.m:
If one remembers [her] three times, saying "Svadhā, Svadhā, Svadhā",
he attains the fruit of a śrāddha, as well as of the [proper] time and water-offerings. / / 28 /

2.41.s:
śrāddhakāle svadhāstotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ..
labhecchrāddhaśatānāṃ ca puṇyameva na saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
2.41.d:
श्राद्धकाले स्वधास्तोत्रं यः शृणोति समाहितः ॥
लभेच्छ्राद्धशतानां च पुण्यमेव न संशयः ॥ 29 ॥
2.41.m:
Whoever, with concentrated mind, listens to the hymn of praise to Svadhā at the time of a śrāddha,
gains the very merit of a hundred śrāddhas; of this there is no doubt. / / 29 /

2.41.s:
svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..
priyāṃ vinītāṃ sa labhetsādhvīṃ putraṃ guṇānvitam ..2.41.30..
2.41.d:
स्वधा स्वधा स्वधेत्येवं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ॥
प्रियां विनीतां स लभेत्साध्वीं पुत्रं गुणान्वितम् ॥2.41.30॥
2.41.m:
The man who recites "Svadhā, Svadhā, Svadhā" at the three junctures of the day
obtains a beloved, humble, virtuous wife and a son endowed with good qualities. / / 2.41.30 /

2.41.s:
pitṝṇāṃ prāṇatulyā tvaṃ dvijajīvanarūpiṇī ..
śrāddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca śrāddhādīnāṃ phalapradā .. 31 ..
2.41.d:
पितॄणां प्राणतुल्या त्वं द्विजजीवनरूपिणी ॥
श्राद्धाधिष्ठातृदेवी च श्राद्धादीनां फलप्रदा ॥ 31 ॥
2.41.m:
You are equal to the life-breath of the ancestors, having the form of the sustenance of the twice-born,
the presiding goddess of the śrāddha, and the granter of the fruits of śrāddhas and other rites. / / 31 /

2.41.s:
bahirmanmanaso gaccha pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭihetave ..
saṃprītaye dvijātīnāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ vṛddhihetave .. .. 32 ..
2.41.d:
बहिर्मन्मनसो गच्छ पितॄणां तुष्टिहेतवे ॥
संप्रीतये द्विजातीनां गृहिणां वृद्धिहेतवे ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
2.41.m:
Go forth from my mind for the satisfaction of the ancestors,
for the delight of the twice-born, and for the prosperity of householders. / / 32 /

2.41.s:
nityā nityasvarūpā'si guṇarūpā'si suvrate ..
āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sṛṣṭau ca pralaye tava.. 33 ..
2.41.d:
नित्या नित्यस्वरूपाऽसि गुणरूपाऽसि सुव्रते ॥
आविर्भावस्तिरोभावः सृष्टौ च प्रलये तव॥ 33 ॥
2.41.m:
You are eternal, whose nature is eternal; O virtuous lady, you have the form of the gunas;
your manifestation is in creation, and your disappearance is in dissolution. / / 33 /

2.41.s:
oṃ svasti ca namaḥ svāhā svadhā tvaṃ dakṣiṇā tathā ..
nirūpitāścaturvede ṣaṭ praśastāśca karmiṇām .. 34 ..
2.41.d:
ओं स्वस्ति च नमः स्वाहा स्वधा त्वं दक्षिणा तथा ॥
निरूपिताश्चतुर्वेदे षट् प्रशस्ताश्च कर्मिणाम् ॥ 34 ॥
2.41.m:
You are "Oṃ", "Svasti", "Namaḥ", "Svāhā", "Svadhā", and also "Dakṣiṇā";
in the four Vedas, these six are prescribed as praiseworthy for performers of rites. / / 34 /

2.41.s:
purā''sīstvaṃ svadhā gopī goloke rādhikā sakhī ..
dhṛtā svorasi kṛṣṇena yatastena svadhā smṛtā .. 35 ..
2.41.d:
पुरा'ऽसीस्त्वं स्वधा गोपी गोलोके राधिका सखी ॥
धृता स्वोरसि कृष्णेन यतस्तेन स्वधा स्मृता ॥ 35 ॥
2.41.m:
Formerly you were a gopī in Goloka named Svadhā, a companion of Rādhikā.
Because you were held on his own chest (sva-urasi) by Kṛṣṇa, you were called Svadhā. / / 35 /

2.41.s:
dhvastā tvaṃ rādhikāśāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā ..
kṛṣṇāśliṣṭā tayā dṛṣṭā purā vṛndāvane vane .. 36 ..
2.41.d:
ध्वस्ता त्वं राधिकाशापाद्गोलोकाद्विश्वमागता ॥
कृष्णाश्लिष्टा तया दृष्टा पुरा वृन्दावने वने ॥ 36 ॥
2.41.m:
Ruined by Rādhikā's curse, you came from Goloka to the universe;
formerly in the forest of Vṛndāvana, she saw you embraced by Kṛṣṇa. / / 36 /

2.41.s:
kṛṣṇāliṃganapuṇyena bhūtā me mānasī sutā ..
atṛptasurate tena caturṇāṃ svāmināṃ priyā .. .. 37 ..
2.41.d:
कृष्णालिंगनपुण्येन भूता मे मानसी सुता ॥
अतृप्तसुरते तेन चतुर्णां स्वामिनां प्रिया ॥ ॥ 37 ॥
2.41.m:
Through the merit of Kṛṣṇa's embrace, you became my mind-born daughter.
Because of insatiable lovemaking, she is beloved by her four lords. / / 37 /

2.41.s:
svāhā sā sundarī gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī ..
ratau svayaṃ kṛṣṇamāha tena svāhā prakīrttitā .. 38 ..
2.41.d:
स्वाहा सा सुन्दरी गोपी पुरा'ऽसीद्राधिकासखी ॥
रतौ स्वयं कृष्णमाह तेन स्वाहा प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ 38 ॥
2.41.m:
That beautiful gopī, Svāhā, was formerly a companion of Rādhikā.
In loveplay she herself spoke (svayam āha) to Kṛṣṇa; therefore she is celebrated as Svāhā. / / 38 /

2.41.s:
kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ suciraṃ vasante rāsamaṇḍale ..
prayattā surate śliṣṭā dṛṣṭā sā rādhayā purā ..39..
2.41.d:
कृष्णेन सार्द्धं सुचिरं वसन्ते रासमण्डले ॥
प्रयत्ता सुरते श्लिष्टा दृष्टा सा राधया पुरा ॥39॥
2.41.m:
Together with Kṛṣṇa for a very long time in the spring in the rāsa circle,
embraced and intent on loveplay, she was seen formerly by Rādhā. / / 39 /

2.41.s:
tasyāḥ śāpena sā dhvastā golokādviśvamāgatā ..
kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena samabhūdvahnikāminī .. 2.41.40 ..
2.41.d:
तस्याः शापेन सा ध्वस्ता गोलोकाद्विश्वमागता ॥
कृष्णालिङ्गनपुण्येन समभूद्वह्निकामिनी ॥ 2.41.40 ॥
2.41.m:
Ruined by her curse, she came from Goloka to the universe;
through the merit of Kṛṣṇa's embrace, she became the beloved wife of the Fire god. / / 2.41.40 /

2.41.s:
pavitrarūpā paramā devādyairvanditā nṛbhiḥ ..
yannāmoccāraṇenaiva naro mucyeta pātakāt .. 41 ..
2.41.d:
पवित्ररूपा परमा देवाद्यैर्वन्दिता नृभिः ॥
यन्नामोच्चारणेनैव नरो मुच्येत पातकात् ॥ 41 ॥
2.41.m:
Supreme, whose form is pure, praised by gods and men,
by merely uttering whose name a man is freed from sin. / / 41 /

2.41.s:
yā suśīlābhidhā gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī ..
uvāsa dakṣiṇe kroḍe kṛṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ .. 42 ..
2.41.d:
या सुशीलाभिधा गोपी पुरा'ऽसीद्राधिकासखी ॥
उवास दक्षिणे क्रोडे कृष्णस्य च महात्मनः ॥ 42 ॥
2.41.m:
The gopī named Suśīlā, who was formerly a companion of Rādhikā,
sat on the right (dakṣiṇa) lap of the great-souled Kṛṣṇa. / / 42 /

2.41.s:
pradhvastā sā ca tacchāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā ..
kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena sā babhūva ca dakṣiṇā .. 43 ..
2.41.d:
प्रध्वस्ता सा च तच्छापाद्गोलोकाद्विश्वमागता ॥
कृष्णालिङ्गनपुण्येन सा बभूव च दक्षिणा ॥ 43 ॥
2.41.m:
She too, ruined by her curse, came from Goloka to the universe;
through the merit of Kṛṣṇa's embrace, she became Dakṣiṇā. / / 43 /

2.41.s:
sā preyasī ratau dakṣā praśastā sarvakarmasu ..
uvāsa dakṣiṇe bharturdakṣiṇā tena kīrttitā .. 44 ..
2.41.d:
सा प्रेयसी रतौ दक्षा प्रशस्ता सर्वकर्मसु ॥
उवास दक्षिणे भर्तुर्दक्षिणा तेन कीर्त्तिता ॥ 44 ॥
2.41.m:
She is his beloved, skilled (dakṣā) in loveplay, praiseworthy in all rites;
she sat on the right (dakṣiṇe) of her lord, therefore she is celebrated as Dakṣiṇā. / / 44 /

2.41.s:
gopyā babhūvustisro vai svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā ..
karmiṇāṃ karmapūrṇārthaṃ purā caiveśvarecchayā .. 49 ..
2.41.d:
गोप्या बभूवुस्तिस्रो वै स्वधा स्वाहा च दक्षिणा ॥
कर्मिणां कर्मपूर्णार्थं पुरा चैवेश्वरेच्छया ॥ 49 ॥
2.41.m:
These three gopīs indeed became Svadhā, Svāhā, and Dakṣiṇā,
for the completion of the rites of ritual performers, formerly by the will of the Lord. / / 49 /

2.41.s:
ityevamuktvā sa brahmā brahmaloke ca saṃsadi ..
tasthau ca sahasā sadyaḥ svadhā sā''virbabhūva ha .. 46 ..
2.41.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मलोके च संसदि ॥
तस्थौ च सहसा सद्यः स्वधा सा'ऽविर्बभूव ह ॥ 46 ॥
2.41.m:
Having spoken thus in the assembly in Brahmaloka, that Brahmā
remained standing; and suddenly Svadhā appeared right then. / / 46 /

2.41.s:
tadā pitṛbhyaḥ pradadau tāmeva kamalānanām ..
tāṃ saṃprāpya yayuste ca pitaraśca praharṣitāḥ .. 47 ..
2.41.d:
तदा पितृभ्यः प्रददौ तामेव कमलाननाम् ॥
तां संप्राप्य ययुस्ते च पितरश्च प्रहर्षिताः ॥ 47 ॥
2.41.m:
Then he gave that lotus-faced lady to the ancestors.
Having obtained her, the ancestors departed exceedingly delighted. / / 47 /

2.41.s:
svadhāstotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ..
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu vedapāṭhaphalaṃ labhet .. 48 ..
2.41.d:
स्वधास्तोत्रमिदं पुण्यं यः शृणोति समाहितः ॥
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु वेदपाठफलं लभेत् ॥ 48 ॥
2.41.m:
Whoever, with concentrated mind, listens to this sacred hymn of praise to Svadhā
is as one who has bathed in all sacred waters, and obtains the fruit of reciting the Vedas. / / 48 /
